adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `calendarReference` was changed from a single reference (`find`) to an array (`filter`) and the code now updates all `_calendar` references in a loop. However, in the merge case (`if (newBookingId)`), it still deletes only one old calendar event via `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`, which will only pick the first matching reference. With multiple `_calendar` references (e.g., multi-host / multiple destination calendars), the other old calendar events would not be deleted, leaving stale duplicates.
